comparison.objective: Slide a booster-seat tray onto two armrests and latch both catches at the second notch.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rail alignment, balanced pushing through paired spring catches, and stopping at a selected detent.
comparison.success_condition: Both catches locked in notch two, tray flat and released, without moving, tipping, or dropping the seat/tray.
comparison.reason: Paired latching shares force regulation only generically; its tested outcome is synchronized seating, not impact fracture and free-fragment recovery.
